c74object.name: sunny.adsr~
c74object.description: Generate one mono attack-decay-sustain-release envelope signal. Message controls are serialized outside the audio callback and take effect in order at the next signal-vector boundary.

method.name: float
method.description: Trigger for a finite positive value; release for a finite zero or negative value.

method.name: gate
method.description: Trigger for a finite positive value; release for a finite zero or negative value.

method.name: attack
method.description: Accept a finite nonnegative duration in seconds.

method.name: decay
method.description: Accept a finite nonnegative duration in seconds.

method.name: sustain
method.description: Accept a finite normalized level from 0 through 1.

method.name: release_time
method.description: Accept a finite nonnegative duration in seconds.

method.name: status
method.description: Post configuration, setup, control, current pending-control, process, and last-error evidence to the Max console. The right message outlet also emits the closed tuple `host_status configured sample_rate maximum_frames process_observed process_calls last_frame_count process_healthy last_error`; `process_calls` is an exact signed saturating callback count and the left outlet remains the sole signal outlet.

method.name: clear_error
method.description: Clear the last-error code without clearing counters or DSP state.
